name: Yu Luochen
source:
A sophomore at Baiyue High School and a member of the Literature Club. She has excellent academic performance and is a knife-edge personality with a heart of gold. She specializes in liberal arts and has won the first provincial award for her articles.

Because of her conscientious and strict personality, she is avoided by all students in her class.

She cares a lot about Zhou Teng and often seeks advice from Ge Cheng, Zhou Teng's best friend, about Zhou Teng's various preferences and habits, but when she really faces Zhou Teng, she often shows a bored attitude of being indifferent.

[Translated from [url=https://www.cngal.org/entries/index/5667]CnGal[/url]]
